intent.raw: Research the promotion mechanism inside out, then use invoke to design the promotion mechanism, then refine the initial design.
intent.objective: Create a governed route that researches GoldenQuill promotion mechanics, produces an invoke-owned initial design, and prepares a refine-owned strategy proposal before any runtime-backed refinement or promotion mutation.
intent.operator_sentence: Research promotion, design the promotion mechanism with Invoke, then refine the initial design.

route_menu.context_hint: The request names a route, not a safe permission to execute runtime-backed refine stages. This dispatch materializes the sequence and stops at Refine strategy confirmation.

items.label: Proposal-only research/design/refine seed
items.description: Do local research, author an initial invoke-style design, write a refine strategy seed, and ask before runtime-backed stages.

items.label: Full refine runtime
items.description: Run the canonical ten-stage refine loop with subagents and runtime-backed stages after explicit permission.

technique_overlays.trigger: Promotion crosses evidence, ontology, inventory, card, org memory, and runtime validation owner boundaries.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Research and design must distinguish evidence capture, candidate state, owner decision, and promoted authority.

technique_overlays.trigger: The proposed mechanism needs low-cost invalid examples before implementation.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design must name positive and negative fixture expectations.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Promotion mechanism research spans multiple owner surfaces and benefits from role-bound critique before implementation.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Subagents can independently inspect Ontology Vault promotion rules, GoldenQuill memory/card authority, fixture design, and smallest-unit critique while the parent owns synthesis.
context: Ontology Vault has candidate PromotionRecord validation rules.
Inventory has promotion_owner but remains a non-authority handoff surface.
GoldenQuill has MemoryEvidencePacket but no first-class promotion decision object.
Refine requires explicit permission before delegated or runtime-backed stages.

roles.purpose: Inspect Ontology Vault and Inventory promotion boundaries.
Inspect GoldenQuill evidence packets, memory mesh, card authority, and org-scope constraints.
Design positive and negative fixtures for the promotion mechanism.
Challenge whether PromotionCandidate is the smallest coherent unit.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the promotion-mechanism refine strategy with the recommended subagents and runtime-backed stages?

steps.name: Research promotion mechanism inside out
stop_conditions: Block if evidence capture is treated as promotion.
Block if retrieval authority is treated as signed or canonical authority.

steps.name: Invoke design the promotion mechanism
convergence_criteria: Design names evidence packet, promotion candidate, promotion record, and ledger boundaries.
Design includes state machine and validation rules.
Design names positive and negative toy fixtures.
stop_conditions: Block if Invoke output claims lifecycle completion or promotion authority.
Flag if the initial slice implies production mutation.

steps.name: Prepare refine strategy for the initial design
convergence_criteria: Refine strategy names overlays, subagent strategy, receipts, runtime plan, and deferred work.
Refine strategy stops before runtime-backed stages until user confirms.

gates.condition: Route artifacts do not claim promotion authority for Inventory, Ontology, definitions, cards, org memory, skills, sigils, or spells.
Every promoted target names its owner and required decision or validation gate.
Runtime-backed refine stages and recommended subagents require explicit confirmation.
Implementation route requires positive and negative fixtures before production mutation.

boundaries.contract: Evidence packets are source references; they do not decide promotion.

boundaries.to_owner: Ontology Vault or GoldenQuill promotion owner
boundaries.contract: Inventory evidence-cards may hand off candidates with non-authority notices; downstream owners decide promotion.
Refine must ask before running subagents or runtime-backed stages.

state_namespaces.write_policy: append-only transition records until a lifecycle owner writes the target artifact

promotion_splits.source: PromotionCandidate, MemoryEvidencePacket, review signal, or generated ledger entry
promotion_splits.rule: No candidate, evidence packet, review signal, or generated ledger entry is promoted authority by itself; the target lifecycle owner must issue the promotion decision.

stop_conditions: Stop before runtime-backed refine execution until the operator confirms.
Stop before subagent execution until the operator confirms.
Block production promotion mutation in this route.
Block any artifact that treats evidence capture, retrieval, scoring, or review as promoted authority.

promotion_guardrail.note: This route creates proposal-only research, initial design, and refine seed artifacts. It does not promote Inventory, Ontology, definitions, cards, org memory, skills, sigils, or spells.
